title: The Five Garments of the First Man and the Pentecost of the Soul
description: From the cosmic descent of the First Man clothed in five garments (each holding five inner powers) and the joining of the Call with the Answer producing twenty characters in twenty members, the teaching unfolds the conveyance of the Living Soul upward — and shows how that primordial event becomes present in the fifty holy days of fasting, the living food by which the soul is filled with power, riches, life, and light until the coming of Jesus the Radiance.
